venues.name: Coca-Cola Amphitheater

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office opens at 3PM on show days only
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: All points of sale will only accept credit or debit via card or mobile pay. This is a cashless venue
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pickup at the box office. Do not forget to bring a photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order. If you need to change the name on your tickets, you will need to reach out to Ticketmaster Customer Service at 800.653.8000. Unfortunately, guests are not able to leave tickets at Will Call for others to pick up. If you are meeting up with friends, we recommend arranging a time and place to hand off tickets directly. If tickets or passes are being left for you including Meet and Greet passes, backstage passes, press or media passes, or tickets from the tour or a promotional company, they will only be available at the box office. These items usually arrive close to door time, so please plan to pick them up then and not earlier. If your tickets or passes are not available yet, please reach out directly to the person who left them for you, as the box office is unable to contact tour staff on behalf of guests.

venues.parkingDetail: Fans will have access to several secure, staffed, and lighted parking options as well as a dedicated rideshare location. Fans can also hop on the brand-new Tram line that connects Uptown Entertainment District to the amphitheater. Pre-paid parking options are now available for a smooth arrival! For more information about parking, visit www.coca-colaamphitheater.com/parking.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes! Please visit www.coca-colaamphitheater.com/accessibility for information on all venue accessibility.

generalInfo.generalRule: For general information for the venue visit www.coca-colaamphitheater.com/know-before-you-go.
generalInfo.childRule: Our venue is all ages, unless otherwise noted on a show. Children 2 and under do not require a ticket, but must sit on a caregiver lap if they are located in the seats.

venues.name: BJCC Concert Hall

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The BJCC Central Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday 9:00am to 4:00pm CT. The Central Ticket Office is located at Legacy Arena, Entry A, 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203. The Concert Hall and Theatre Box Office opens two hours before scheduled start time for most events. Hours may vary for some events.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: MC, VISA, AMX, DISCOVER and Cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available the day of the event at the Concert Hall/Theatre Box Office. For most events, will call opens two hours before the scheduled start time. Hours may vary for some events. Please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Visit www.BJCC.org/plan-your-visit/directions-and-parking for a printable map and to pre-purchase parking. Parking prices vary by event and date. We aim to make navigating the BJCC campus simple using clear directions. With various parking options for events, conventions, and meetings, planning ahead ensures a smoother arrival. Since multiple events often occur simultaneously, arrive early to avoid long parking and entry lines.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Guests requiring accessible seating are guaranteed the ability to purchase at least one (1) companion seat. Subject to availability, guests requiring wheelchair seating may purchase up to a total of three (3) companion seats in the same row and contiguous with the wheelchair seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the wheelchair seat and adjacent companion seat will be offered. If you purchased a ticket in the fixed seating area but require an accessible seat, the Ticket Office may be able to assist you by relocating your ticket to an accessible seat. Please contact the Ticket Office at CTO@bjcc.org if you have any questions or require assistance purchasing tickets. Tickets are subject to availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: The following items are not permitted to be brought into the Complex at any time: laser pointers, food or beverages, glass containers, weapons, cameras, audio or video recorders. The BJCC reserves the right to search all guests entering the Complex and refuse entry at the discretion of management. This is a Smoke Free Facility smoking allowed in designated areas only.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children who have celebrated their 2nd birthday are required to have a ticket. For show specific age restrictions that may supersede our standard policy, visit www.bjcc.org/events
